migrate.title: Item IDs: {{from}} to {{to}}
migrate.hint: Every change of IDs needs an entry. A page or title change that keeps its ID needs none.
migrate.open: These items of the release before have no entry: {{ids}}
migrate.misfits: These IDs don’t fit the release before: {{ids}}
migrate.added: New items, with no entry: {{ids}}. That’s fine if they’re really new.
migrate.noneOpen: Every earlier item is kept or has an entry.
migrate.noneAdded: No new item is waiting. Add it to the draft first.
migrate.problem: This entry doesn’t fit: items of different kinds, or an ID in use. Nothing was saved.
migrate.mapLabel: Items of the release before, and where each went
migrate.onDevice: The rule applies on the teacher’s device when a class moves, and the server never knows a class’s progress. A session count in a teacher’s layer isn’t a split: the teacher is asked before the move.
migrate.otherFrom: These entries start from {{release}}, which this device doesn’t hold. Adding one replaces them.
